newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel oil weaker with crude.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel oil weaker with crude.

text.p: Straight-run fuel oil was slightly weaker with crude and demand was slack for low sulphur North Sea grades, traders said.

But Russian exports were in better shape, they said, partly due to a widening arbitrage to the United States. Two high sulphur cargoes have already been sold to the States from the Baltic, and more would follow.
One trader maintained a bullish outlook, expecting a Turkish high sulphur cracked purchase tender soon.
